title: The German Multiple Sclerosis Registry of the German MS Society
summary:
The MS Registry was established to collect reliable data and get new insights on multiple sclerosis (MS) throughout Germany. The aim is to fill existing gaps in knowledge and improve care for people with MS in the long term. This is important for enabling informed decisions by payers, policymakers, and government agencies— for example, regarding better care services, support in daily life, or improved treatment options. The data also help to assess and understand the safety of MS treatments. In addition, the MS Registry supports research: The collected data help scientists to identify new treatment approaches and to understand the disease.

All facilities participating in the registry record the information according to a standardized data set. The data is collected as part of routine care—no additional examinations are performed.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- MS as defined by McDonald Criteria or clinical isolated syndrom
- written informed consent
- primary residence in Germany
Exclusion criteria:
- non determinable MS disease course (except CIS)
- missing ability to consent
